description:
* Receiving data from the branches and clarifying information with related departments.
* Contract breakdown, manage to keep consistent information.
* Create new hotel codes for hotels of all countries (except VN hotels).
* Create new rooms/rateplans/promotions for hotels of all countries (except VN hotels).
* Input and double-check rates for hotels of all countries (except VN hotels).
* Update information and pictures (after resizing) for hotels of all countries.
* Check and calculate final price from hotel’s basic price.
* Check and create mapping list for sending to Channels.
* Daily check and preview hotel/room mapping and mapping status with channels
* Process manual mapping on Channel’s portal if any.
* Investigate, follow up and solve mapping issues with channels.
* Map/ Remove hotel on Channels as request from PIC.
* Manual mapping for third party.
* Find hotel information on the hotel’s official website and update on Alice system.
* Find code channels to make new mapping list.
* Clarify information & compare data.
* Daily Report/ Weekly Report/ API Report.
* Create content and write on Naver Blog.
* Pre-intermediate Excel skills (priority)
requirements_text:

* Speed of handling tasks: Proficient typing speed, case resolving, and accuracy.
* Familiarity with Software: Comfortable with data entry software, spreadsheets (Excel, Google Sheets), and database management systems.
* Time Management: Ability to manage time effectively and prioritize tasks.
* Communication Skills: Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Problem-Solving: Ability to identify and correct errors in data.
* Attitude: can-do attitude, active and responsible in tasks.
* At least 01 year of experience in data entry
